name: sglang_fl_rotary_embedding
description: Apply position-indexed rotary embedding to query and key in place. Their rows store flattened heads of head_size lanes. Split the last dimension of cos_sin_cache into cosine and sine halves; its width determines the rotary width. With is_neox=True pair the two halves of the rotary region; otherwise pair even and odd lanes. Leave lanes beyond the rotary width unchanged and return the same query and key tensors.
